result.Method of Attack: Phishing emails with fake hotel booking PDF attachment that downloads a .NET executable which runs a PowerShell script to fetch and execute a Python-based information stealer compressed with cx-Freeze; steals credentials, system info, browser sessions, cryptocurrency extensions; terminates certain processes; takes screenshots; collects IP and geolocation; scans files and wallets; compresses and uploads stolen data to public file-sharing and Telegram channel
result.Attack Vector: Phishing email with malicious PDF attachment containing downloader link; use of .NET executable (adobe.exe) to unpack and run PowerShell script (down2.ps1); PowerShell script downloads and executes cx-Freeze packed Python malware (python.exe)
